title: 4 Day Québec City and Scenic Countryside Tour
includes: 3 nights’ accommodation at Delta Hotels by Marriott Québec
Guided Walking Tour of Old Quebec
Transportation to and from Québec City (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Travellers joining in Québec City may check in independently at the designated hotel and meet the group there.
Each traveler may bring one medium-sized suitcase. During transportation, luggage is placed in the vehicle’s designated storage compartment for convenient, hands-free travel.
Every departure is unique. The order and timing of activities may be adjusted due to traffic, weather, local events or other travel conditions.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover Québec City without the stress of planning on this carefully organized four-day group tour. Stay three nights in historic Old Québec and explore the city with a knowledgeable local guide. Beyond the city, experience Montmorency Falls and the scenic countryside of Île d’Orléans, including selected local tastings.

With transportation, accommodations, breakfasts, guided sightseeing and selected admissions included, you can relax and enjoy the journey. The itinerary balances organized experiences with free time to explore independently.

This tour is well suited to culture lovers, couples, friends and independent travelers who want to experience Québec City and its surrounding countryside in one convenient trip. Solo travelers are welcome to join the existing group and may reserve a private room at the single-occupancy rate. No private group booking is required.
